ATEC Spine is committed to Revolutionizing the Approach to Spine Surgery.

[ About Us ][67]

# Valence^{®}: Purpose-built for spine surgery

Valence unifies navigation and robotics into a seamless platform designed to advance ATEC’s
procedures. Featuring a surgeon-controlled in-field camera, intentionally designed software, and a
comprehensive suite of navigated instruments, Valence delivers clarity and control at every step of
the procedure.

## ATEC Spine Latest News

[ATEC_Q1 26 Social Post_043026]

### ATEC Reports First Quarter Financial Results

May 5, 2026
* Surgical revenue grew 17%; total revenue grew 14%
* Net new surgeon users increased 23% year over year, reinforcing durable growth
* Adjusted EBITDA of $21 million, or 11% of revenue, expanded 460 basis points year over year
* Company announces refinancing of existing debt with inaugural bank facility, reducing interest
  expense by more than $6 million annually and extending maturities to 2031

[ VIEW PRESS RELEASE ][96]
[LinkedIn Newsletter_Website_March]

### March Society Meeting Highlights

April 3, 2026

March was defined by continued momentum in surgeon education and collaboration, with ATEC
participating in key society meetings and regional symposia across the country. Each event provided
an opportunity to engage with surgeons, share procedural insights, and highlight innovations
designed to support better surgical decision-making and patient outcomes.

[ VIEW FULL ARTICLE ][97]
[LinkedIn Newsletter_Website_Feb]

### February Society Meeting Highlights

March 9, 2026

February reflected the global momentum behind surgeon-driven education and data-informed spine care.
From deformity-focused collaboration in Asia Pacific to high-level cranial and spine discussions at
Winter Clinics and innovation in lateral surgery at Spine Summit, each meeting reinforced a shared
priority: advancing precision through planning, technology integration, and procedural discipline.

#### **Welcome to the future of orthopaedics.**

robotics and enabling tech, spine, sports, trauma, and extremities, to develop the next generation

# We Keep People Moving

#### **Keeping people moving isn’t just a tagline; it’s our passion.** 
#### **Welcome to the future of orthopaedics.**

[ View All Products ][28]

We are on a mission to keep people moving by leveraging our deep expertise in joint reconstruction,
robotics and enabling tech, spine, sports, trauma, and extremities, to develop the next generation
of medtech solutions. We offer one of the most comprehensive Orthopaedics portfolios in the world
that helps heal and restore movement for the millions of patients we serve.

## The History of Henry Schein

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

# We're on the move.

Visit us at globusmedical.com for the latest on our company, procedures and technologies. We have
several pages linked in the menu below for reference as we continue to transition this site.

[Visit globusmedical.com][40]
NCS Neuromonitoring

NCS is committed to providing hospitals, surgeons, and patients a best-in-class IONM experience. NCS
combines industry-leading technology, service, and quality to serve over 100,000 cases annually. Our
team of board-certified neurologists and neurophysiologists are highly trained professionals aiming
to provide the highest-quality intraoperative neuromonitoring service possible and is supported by
an industry-leading training and educational program.

## Medical Devices & Solutions

[Spine Solutions - Spine Procedures]

## [Spinal Solutions][77]

Orthofix’s complete spine portfolio provides reconstructive and regenerative solutions that aim to
restore the quality of life for patients with various spinal and bone-related conditions. Our
innovative solutions uniquely incorporate different treatment modalities (mechanical, biological and
electromagnetic) to achieve desired clinical outcomes. Our goal is to help patients maintain their
range of motion or achieve successful spinal fusions.

[Spinal Solutions][78]  | [Biologics][79]  |  [Spinal Fusion Therapy][80]

[Orthopedic]

## [Limb Reconstruction][81]

Orthofix is an industry leader with a unique portfolio of limb reconstruction solutions, addressing
the most challenging congenital, developmental, and acquired orthopedic conditions in patients of
all ages.

We remain focused on the complete patient pathway, supporting clinicians and patients through
continuous innovation of hardware and enabling technologies, clinical evidence and industry-leading
medical education programs.

[Limb Reconstruction][82]  |  [Biologics ][83]

## [Surgical Navigation][84]

The 7D FLASH™ Navigation System revolutionizes surgical precision by combining unmatched accuracy,
efficient workflow and a reduced to completely radiation-free experience. Its machine-vision
technology rapidly captures and reconstructs a highly detailed 3D image, ensuring precise
navigation. FLASH Registration streamlines workflow, reducing patient registration time from 30
minutes to as little as 30 seconds, allowing surgeons to focus entirely on the patient rather than
cumbersome technology. With a fully sterile-field-controlled interface, the system eliminates
reliance on additional staff, enhancing surgical autonomy and efficiency. By delivering superior
accuracy with a seamless workflow, 7D FLASH Navigation empowers surgeons to operate with confidence
while prioritizing patient safety — and continues to innovate boldly, redefining the future of
surgical navigation.

[Spine Navigation System][85] | [Cranial Navigation System][86]
[7D FLASH EVD][87]

## [Therapeutic Solutions][88]

Orthofix Therapeutic Solutions are redefining recovery through a diverse, coordinated portfolio that
brings together non-invasive bone growth therapies, bracing solutions, and dedicated patient support
through a single, trusted partner. Our approach streamlines access to multiple recovery tools,
creating a more seamless experience for providers and patients. With decades of experience
supporting recovery pathways and a legacy grounded in clinical evidence, Orthofix Therapeutic
Solutions are designed to help keep patients engaged and supported throughout their healing journey.

[Bone Growth Therapies][89] | [Bracing Solutions][90]

Orthofix is committed to responsible environmental practices that include conservation of natural

prevalent, we recognize the need to comply with increased regulations and stricter environmental
standards. We believe that our focus on environmental sustainability, with the objective of reducing
costs and improving sustainability of our operations, will provide a strategic benefit.

## Professional Orthopedic Implant Manufacturer & Global Exporter

**Axiora Medical Technology (China) Co., Ltd.** is a professional manufacturer specializing in the
research, development, production, and global supply of high-quality orthopedic implants and
surgical instruments. Our product portfolio covers trauma fixation systems, spinal implants, joint
reconstruction solutions, sports medicine products, and related orthopedic surgical instruments.

Established with a commitment to innovation and precision manufacturing, Axiora integrates advanced
CNC machining, automated production lines, and strict quality management systems to deliver reliable
products that meet international standards. Our experienced engineering team continuously develops
innovative solutions to support surgeons and healthcare providers worldwide.

"With strong OEM and ODM capabilities, we provide customized manufacturing services according to
customers' drawings, samples, and technical requirements. From product design and prototyping to
mass production and packaging, our integrated manufacturing process ensures consistent quality,
competitive pricing, and on-time delivery."
✅ ISO 13485 Compliant 🌍 50+ Export Countries 🔧 OEM / ODM Ready 📐 Drawing-Based Manufacturing 🏭

🏢 About Axiora

## Professional Orthopedic Implant Manufacturer & Global Exporter

**Axiora Medical Technology (China) Co., Ltd.** is a professional manufacturer specializing in the
research, development, production, and global supply of high-quality orthopedic implants and
surgical instruments. Our product portfolio covers trauma fixation systems, spinal implants, joint
reconstruction solutions, sports medicine products, and related orthopedic surgical instruments.

Established with a commitment to innovation and precision manufacturing, Axiora integrates advanced
CNC machining, automated production lines, and strict quality management systems to deliver reliable
products that meet international standards. Our experienced engineering team continuously develops
innovative solutions to support surgeons and healthcare providers worldwide.

"With strong OEM and ODM capabilities, we provide customized manufacturing services according to
customers' drawings, samples, and technical requirements. From product design and prototyping to
mass production and packaging, our integrated manufacturing process ensures consistent quality,
competitive pricing, and on-time delivery."
✅ ISO 13485 Compliant 🌍 50+ Export Countries 🔧 OEM / ODM Ready 📐 Drawing-Based Manufacturing 🏭
18,600 m² Factory ⚡ 8 Years Export Experience

pro**disc® C Vivo** Cadaveric Surgical Technique Demonstration

This video is a cadaveric surgical technique demonstration of the pro**disc C Vivo** Cervical Total
Disc Replacement System—developed in conjunction with the Cervical Spine Research Society (CSRS) and
performed by Dr. Philip Louie, Spine Surgeon and Medical Director of Research and Academics at the
Center for Neurosciences and Spine, Virginia Mason Franciscan Health, in Tacoma, WA.

The video features Dr. Louie performing the procedure on a cadaver where he demonstrates the removal
of a degenerated cervical disc and replacement of this disc with pro**disc C Vivo**, a total disc
replacement for motion preservation and relief of pain in the cervical spine, or neck.

cervical TDR portfolio that allows matching the disc to patient anatomy.

This short video highlights the benefits of having four FDA-approved cervical Total Disc Replacement
devices to address surgeon preference and individual patient anatomy—each powered by pro**disc®
CORE** Technology, the articulating design feature driving the kinematics of every prodisc device
and central to the reproducible positive clinical outcomes of the pro**disc** technology platform
over the past 30 years.

features the Match-the-Disc™ System of Anatomic Endplates™—designed to better match patient anatomy
and allow a customized fit throughout the full range of indicated levels (L3-S1).

## [ NEWS: Dr. Neel Anand Appointed President of The Society for Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery
## (SMISS) ][50]

The Anand Spine Group is excited to announce that renowned spine surgeon Dr. Neel Anand, Professor
of Orthopaedic Surgery and Neurosurgery and Medical Director of the Department of Orthopaedic
Surgery and Neurosurgery at Cedars Sinai Medical Center at Cedars-Sinai Medical Center in Los
Angeles, has been appointed President of The Society for Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery (SMISS)
for the 2025–2026 term.

[ Click here to learn more ][51]

## [ STUDY: Segmental Interbody, Muscle-Preserving, Ligamentotaxis-Enabled Reduction: “SIMPLER”
## Technique for cMIS Correction of ASD ][52]

Correction of adult spinal deformity (ASD) through minimally invasive techniques is a challenging
endeavor and has typically been reserved for experienced surgeons. This publication aims to be the
first high-resolution technique guide to demonstrate a reproducible technique for ASD correction
utilizing circumferential minimally invasive surgery (cMIS) without an osteotomy. The Segmental
Interbody, Muscle-Preserving, Ligamentotaxis-Enabled Reduction (SIMPLER) technique is a novel
ligamentotaxis-based scoliosis surgery that represents a paradigm shift from traditional osteotomies
toward patient-specific correction.

[ Click here to learn more ][53]
[ [A blue word that says latest news.] ][54]

### [ News and Blogs ][55]

The Anand Spine Group takes great pride in sharing the latest [news][56] in minimally invasive spine
surgery. Dr. Anand has been on multiple medias over the years talking about latest technology and
techniques in spine surgery. He is considered the expert in minimally invasive spine care and is
leading the way in minimally invasive spine deformity correction. He loves to educate and provide
the latest up to date technology that is available.

Neel Anand is invited to present at the spine industry's most prestigious conferences and meetings.

(FREMISS) that global aid is provided. The FREMISS Global Aid program is designed to benefit not
only surgeons, but also patients in under privileged regions of the world. With your support, we can
expand our research, strengthen our programs and improve the future of spinal care to patients
around the world.

# FREMISS

It is through the Foundation for Research and Education in Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery
(FREMISS) that global aid is provided. The FREMISS Global Aid program is designed to benefit not
only surgeons, but also patients in under privileged regions of the world. With your support, we can
expand our research, strengthen our programs and improve the future of spinal care to patients
around the world.

Additionally, FREMISS supports several educational opportunities for spine surgeons. The
[Comprehensive Minimally Invasive & Outpatient Spine Surgery Fellowship][62] is an academic
experience offered to spine surgeons who desire to train in minimally invasive techniques with Dr.
Anand and conduct research. Upon graduation, fellows are encouraged to take their knowledge into
various communities around the country. The [Visiting Surgeon Program][63] welcomes spine surgeons
from around the world to spend time with Dr. Anand in clinic and in the operating room to better
understand the philosophy and application of minimally invasive and outpatient techniques.   

Thank you for your generosity which allows us to continue our mission.

surgeries.

All Prodorth instrumentation is CE-certified and fully compatible with both degenerative and
deformity cases, customizable to each customer’s needs.

Prodorth Spine is an innovative medical device manufacturer specializing in spinal implant systems
and orthopedic solutions, backed by over 14 years of industry expertise. Operating in more than 30
countries, we supply precision-engineered spinal implants designed to meet the demands of global
healthcare markets. Our products are developed in accordance with the European Medical Device
Regulation (MDR) and fully comply with international quality, safety, and regulatory standards.

 

Our mission is to empower surgeons with reliable spinal implant technologies, support distributors
through sustainable partnership models, and advance the future of spinal healthcare through
engineering-driven innovation and vertically integrated manufacturing excellence.

## 事業のご案内

**●医療機器メーカー、医療機器製造業、2つの事業を行っております。

**

**●CNC施盤加工・マシニング加工**
チタン加工、ステンレス加工、プラスチック加工を行っております。
特にチタン加工を得意としており、チタンM2タップ、M2ネジ、特殊ネジ等に多くの実績があります。

**●設計製作・受託生産**
お客様のご要望やご意見を形にしていく技術力とアフターケアを最も大切にしております。
試作や、100個程度の小ロット等、何でもお申し付けください。

**●設計～生産～組立～滅菌～包装

部品加工、特殊加工、包装のみにも対応しております。

**●医療機器メーカー、医療機器製造業、2つの事業を行っております。

**

**●CNC施盤加工・マシニング加工**
チタン加工、ステンレス加工、プラスチック加工を行っております。

**●設計製作・受託生産**

部品加工、特殊加工、包装のみにも対応しております。

インプラントや手術用機器やその医療機器部品など、衛生面から取り組んだ精度の高い医療機器を提供いたしま
す。

# The Blueprint of Healing

Siora Surgicals Pvt. Ltd. is a hub of continuous innovation driven by the excellence of decades of
expertise and a dedicated team of professionals. Having made its presence in the year 1987, Siora
has sailed a ship of steady growth since then. We have our state-of-the-art manufacturing facility
in the RAI District, Sonepat, Haryana, equipped with advanced CNC and VMC machines sourced from top
international vendors. Siora maintains a huge inventory of ready-to-dispatch, CE-certified
orthopedic implants and instruments made from medical-grade stainless steel and titanium. The
company enjoys a huge clientele base spanning over 50 countries, and it is growing above and beyond.

Siora aims to build a world where even the severest of orthopedic injuries can be managed
effectively, improving the quality of life afterward.

40+ Countries

expertise and a dedicated team of professionals. Having made its presence in the year 1987, Siora
has sailed a ship of steady growth since then. We have our state-of-the-art manufacturing facility
in the RAI District, Sonepat, Haryana, equipped with advanced CNC and VMC machines sourced from top
international vendors. Siora maintains a huge inventory of ready-to-dispatch, CE-certified
orthopedic implants and instruments made from medical-grade stainless steel and titanium. The
company enjoys a huge clientele base spanning over 50 countries, and it is growing above and beyond.

Siora aims to build a world where even the severest of orthopedic injuries can be managed

## SpineShape is the dynamic solution for the back. Less pain. Less drugs. Less stiffness.

More freedom for patients and flexibility for surgeons.

[SYSTEM IV VIDEO][37][THE SOLUTION][38]

  Developed and manufactured in Switzerland – Medical domain

# We are pioneers in dynamic spine systems

SpineSave has dedicated itself to motion preservation implant systems and offers solutions, which on
one hand are based on proven methods and on the other hand are featured with stepwise innovations.

[THIS IS SPINESAVE][39]
[Link to: Operation Technique][40]

## Technique

SpineShape System IV is an implant system which relies on the pedicular fixation, a standard
procedure in spine surgery.

[Link to: The Solution][41]

## [The solution][42]

“My back feels well again.” SpineShape System IV – Dynamic stabilisation of the lumbar spine with
three selectable flexibilities.

[Link to: Results][43]

## Results

## Spineway designs innovative technologies for spinal surgery

][38]

Spineway is an independent French company, founded in Lyon in 2005, specializing in the design and
development of innovative technologies for spine surgery. By combining French expertise with an
international network, we have seized major growth opportunities with the acquisitions of Distimp in
2021 and Spine Innovations in 2022. These integrations have enable us to broaden our offering by
combining complementary product portfolios and territories, while proposing innovative solutions to
treat new pathologies. Much more than just a manufacturer, we are committed to our surgeon partners.
We offer a global program of customized training courses in surgical techniques, tailored to meet
the specific needs of practitioners.

## Spineway Academy

Our medical education department is dedicated to provide healthcare professionals at all levels of
expertise with continuous and dedicated educational training programs, as well as scientific
content, on our advanced treatments for cervical and thoracolumbar spinal diseases.

## Who We Are

We are a medical device company focused on improving the quality of life for patients undergoing
spine surgery. We develop motion-preserving technologies designed to treat degenerative disc disease
while supporting the spine’s natural curvature.

Our flagship product, the FDA-approved Synergy Disc^{®}, features a built-in 6-degree lordotic core
designed to not only preserve motion but also improve sagittal alignment.

[Learn more About Us][29]

## Synergy Disc

The Synergy Disc is the first and only artificial cervical disc designed to improve alignment and
provide intentional motion preservation, using time-tested and trusted materials.

[Learn More about Synergy Disc][30]
[Synergy Disc]The Synergy Disc is commercially available in the United States, the United Kingdom,
Europe, Australia, Canada (SAP), South Africa, and Malaysia.

## Who We Are

We are a medical device company focused on improving the quality of life for patients undergoing
spine surgery. We develop motion-preserving technologies designed to treat degenerative disc disease
while supporting the spine’s natural curvature.

Our flagship product, the FDA-approved Synergy Disc^{®}, features a built-in 6-degree lordotic core
designed to not only preserve motion but also improve sagittal alignment.

[Learn more About Us][29]

## Synergy Disc

The Synergy Disc is the first and only artificial cervical disc designed to improve alignment and
provide intentional motion preservation, using time-tested and trusted materials.

[Learn More about Synergy Disc][30]
[Synergy Disc]The Synergy Disc is commercially available in the United States, the United Kingdom,
Europe, Australia, Canada (SAP), South Africa, and Malaysia.

[development][185] environment, specifically optimized to **run on modern Windows operating
systems**. The original DOS-based software was a favorite for many programmers, but it became
incompatible with newer versions of Windows. This program was **developed to bridge that gap**.

## Professional Orthopedic Implant Manufacturer & Bone Fusion Specialist

Zynfuse Medical Technology Co., Ltd. is a professional orthopedic medical device manufacturer
specializing in bone fusion and advanced implant systems for surgical innovation. Established in
**2016**, the company has built a strong foundation in orthopedic solutions with **12 years of
industry experience** and **7 years of export experience**, serving global healthcare markets with
consistent quality and reliability.

The company operates a modern manufacturing facility covering approximately **18,600 m²**, equipped
with advanced production and testing equipment. Zynfuse maintains an annual export revenue of around
**$18.5 million**, supported by a highly efficient supply chain network of over **1,200 partners**
worldwide. The organization employs **68 quality inspection specialists** ensuring strict compliance
with international medical standards.

All implants undergo rigorous fatigue testing, tensile load verification, and mechanical performance

human body, aligned with ISO 10993 standards.

📐

Precision dimensional inspection using advanced 2D video measuring instruments and spectrometer
analysis ensures every implant meets exact surgical specifications.
